title: Exact Home value readers
description: SP-273 dispatches retained canonical Home1, frozen external Home2 compatibility and current Home3 slot/receipt values. Checkpoint remains exact Home1. This reader union grants no writer or pending-conversion authority.
$comment: Original assertion-bearing reader definitions are referenced unchanged; external Home2 provenance is not deployment evidence. Native reader installation remains NOT_RUN. Amended 2026-10-09 (DL-180, Plans/storage-plan.md#SP-330): this contract is typed for v1 Home layouts and the 1.1.0 workspace.layout_changed payload, and it stays the reader for v1 records and their unresolved operations, which SP-330's conversion reads as input. A v2 Home layout write needs a successor slot and receipt contract that references pm.home_workspace_layout.v2 (Plans/home_workspace_layout_v2.schema.json) and the 2.0.0 payload of Plans/Contracts_V0.md#CV-361 by $ref instead of copying them; until it exists no v2 write is admitted through this contract.
